front: In AWS Backup, the retention period of a continuous backup can range from {{c1::1 day to 35 days}}.
In AWS Backup Vault Lock, the grace time of a compliance-mode lock is {{c1::at least 3 days (72 hours)}}.
In AWS Backup, a backup that moves to cold storage stays there for a {{c1::minimum of 90 days}}.
In an AWS Backup rule, snapshot backups can be taken {{c1::as frequently as every hour}}.
In AWS Backup, a point-in-time restore of an Amazon RDS database reaches the {{c1::most recent 5 minutes of activity}}.
In AWS Backup Vault Lock, governance mode or compliance mode: which lock can a user with enough IAM permissions remove?
extra: A governance-mode vault can have its [lock removed by users with sufficient IAM permissions](../facts/backup.md#backup-vault-lock-governance-lock-removable-with-iam). After the grace time, a compliance-mode lock [cannot be altered or deleted by any user](../facts/backup.md#backup-vault-lock-compliance-immutable-by-anyone).

front: In AWS Backup, can you restore a cross-Region copy of a continuous backup to a point in time?
back: No. The copy becomes a snapshot backup.
extra: A cross-Region or cross-account copy of a continuous backup [becomes a snapshot (periodic) backup](../facts/backup.md#backup-continuous-copy-becomes-snapshot-no-pitr), and point-in-time restore [is not available for these copies](../facts/backup.md#backup-continuous-copy-becomes-snapshot-no-pitr).

front: In AWS Backup, does the KMS key of the backup vault encrypt the Amazon RDS snapshots stored in it?
back: No. They keep the key of the source database.
extra: The vault key [applies to the backups of certain resource types](../facts/backup.md#backup-vault-key-applies-only-to-independent-encryption-types). RDS snapshots use the same key that was used to [encrypt the source Amazon RDS database](../facts/backup.md#backup-encryption-rds-row).

front: In AWS Backup, an account in another organization must restore your backups. Which kind of backup vault do you share?
back: A logically air-gapped vault, shared through AWS RAM.
extra: These vaults are shared [through AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM)](../facts/backup.md#backup-faq-lag-vault-share-ram), also [with accounts in different Organizations](../facts/backup.md#backup-faq-lag-vault-share-ram). For copy actions, the accounts [must belong to the same organization](../facts/backup.md#backup-cross-account-requires-same-organization).

front: In AWS Backup, auditors want automated, periodic proof that your backups can be restored. Which feature do you turn on?
extra: It gives [automated and periodic evaluation of restore viability](../facts/backup.md#backup-restore-testing-automated-periodic-evaluation). The Audit Manager control [Restore time for resources meet target](../facts/backup.md#backup-audit-manager-control-restore-time) checks the restore duration.

front: In AWS Backup, can the backups of an Amazon Aurora cluster move to cold storage?
back: No. Aurora has no lifecycle to cold storage.
extra: In the feature table, [Amazon Aurora](../facts/backup.md#backup-feature-row-aurora) has no check mark for lifecycle to cold storage. The cold storage setting is [ignored for other resources](../facts/backup.md#backup-cold-storage-ignored-for-unsupported-resources).

front: AWS Backup or Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager: which one manages backups of many AWS services from a single place?
extra: AWS Backup manages backups across services [from a single place](../facts/backup.md#backup-faq-dlm-vs-backup-when-to-use). Data Lifecycle Manager automates the [creation, retention, and deletion of EBS snapshots](../facts/backup.md#backup-faq-dlm-vs-backup-when-to-use).
